project_type: Python FastAPI monorepo (backend) + Cloudflare Workers (edge) for educational AI assistant
build_system: pip + requirements.txt for backend, npm + wrangler for edge
build_command: N/A for this task (shell script only)
verification_instructions: Run bash -n on the script to validate syntax. Verify the script references all config vars from apps/backend/app/config.py.
setup_instructions: N/A - this task creates a new shell script
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Script is for user to run locally with gcloud CLI, not executed in sandbox.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing infra/gcp/ conventions. Script should be executable and well-commented.
key_patterns: Existing infra uses: clouddeploy.yaml (Cloud Run knative service), vertex-search-schema.json (Discovery Engine schema with structured fields: id, title, content, language, tier_access, source_url, last_updated). Backend uses discoveryengine_v1 Python SDK. Config vars: VERTEX_PROJECT_ID, VERTEX_SEARCH_DATASTORE_ID, VERTEX_SEARCH_SERVING_CONFIG (default_search), VERTEX_SEARCH_LOCATION (global), GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON, VERTEX_GEMINI_MODEL (gemini-2.0-flash-lite), VERTEX_LOCATION (us-central1).
directory_structure: infra/gcp/ contains Cloud Run service YAML and Vertex Search schema. infra/scripts/ contains Python scripts for deploying schema and seeding data. apps/backend/app/config.py defines all environment variables the backend needs.
